# Plans and ongoing work

Follow `SKILL.md`. State scope up front, keep the topic brief current, and put
routine steps in one `task` checklist. Split a step only for an independent
owner choice, risk or separately owned work.

Start your task `in_progress` with `note`; update its checklist/progress using
`item.edit.patch.note`. Work for someone else is `open` with
`owner: {"kind":"other","name":"N"}`. Consent goes on its own item using the
question shape, within the three-waiting-question limit.

Finish work `open` with `ack_to: "done"`, `outcome` and `why`; a finished choice
uses `ack_to: "decided"`. Reading unfinished work targets `open` or `in_progress`.
Finishing children is not Ack: keep any parent's Ack for the owner.

Finish an existing parent in the same request as its last child only when you
own it, your work is complete, and it has no unanswered ask/message or follow-up
you owe. Guard both revisions, explain the result, and leave it `open` with
its deliberate `ack_to`; if work reopens, update progress instead.

## Example

One task tracks the routine migration; the brief describes its scope.
